relationships.evidence: JRC states that detailed ILCD guidance is based on and conforms to ISO 14040/14044.
relationships.constraints: Some guidance predates current EU programme profiles.
relationships.validation_question: Record which handbook component each programme still references.

relationships.evidence: worldsteel states that the LCI study follows ISO 14040 and ISO 14044.
relationships.constraints: Conformance details depend on study report and review.
relationships.validation_question: Review current detailed study report when published.

relationships.evidence: ISO presents ISO 14040 and ISO 14044 as the current principles/framework and requirements/guidelines pair.
relationships.constraints: Amendments and sector standards can add requirements.
